sources.snippet: What is SmolLM2? SmolLM2 is HuggingFace's open-weights language model. Released in 2024-11, it ships in 3 sizes (135M, 360M, 1.7B) and is licensed Apache 2.0. The most popular use case is small chat and tool use on any hardware.
